_metadata.description: Point-at library model with reliable playback and no mutation of source files.

requirements.title: Source files are never moved or mutated
requirements.description: The library points at listener-managed folders and treats them as read-only. Scanning, tagging, and analysis never write to, rename, relocate, or delete a source file. Managed storage holds only generated audio and derived artifacts.

validation.notes: No write path exists to a source root; scan is provably read-only

requirements.title: Scan is incremental and resumable
requirements.description: Library scanning detects additions, moves, and deletions without a full re-read, survives interruption, and resumes from where it stopped. Track identity is content-derived so a moved or retagged file is not treated as a new track.

validation.notes: Incremental scan resumes; moved files retain identity and history

requirements.title: Playback covers formats the browser cannot decode
requirements.description: Playback serves lossless and uncommon formats by transcoding on demand rather than refusing them, preserves gapless playback where the source supports it, and never rewrites the source to achieve either.

validation.notes: Non-native formats stream successfully; gapless boundaries preserved; source untouched

requirements.title: Playback control is fully keyboard-operable
requirements.description: Transport, queue manipulation, and rating are reachable and operable by keyboard alone, with state changes announced to assistive technology.

validation.notes: All transport and queue actions keyboard-reachable with announced state
